title: Gate-operation sequence
statement: For a gate kind and a list of linear expressions in 11 registers, form the operation list beginning with an instruction to print true, followed by the bit-encoding operations for the gate kind. For each linear expression in order, append an instruction to print true, the operations for that expression, and an instruction to print false; finish with another instruction to print false.
caveat: The supplied context does not give informal definitions of the bit-encoding and linear-expression operation sequences.
